# Gurudwara Map

> A comprehensive directory of Gurudwaras (Sikh temples) across Canada and beyond, helping users locate places of worship and community centers in their area.

Gurudwara Map is a trusted resource for the Sikh community, providing detailed listings of Gurudwaras with information about locations, services, and community offerings. The platform serves users across Canada, the United States, and Australia, with a focus on spiritual centers that offer Langar (community meals) and other religious services.

## Key Topics

- Gurudwara
- Sikh community
